findings.summary: matchesQuery combines filters with OR (predicates.some(Boolean)) instead of AND, so any combined-filter search returns capsules satisfying only one supplied filter. Confirmed live: created two capsules with disjoint name/occasion markers, then GET /api/v1/capsules?q=Zzq Alpha&occasion=zzq-occ-beta returned both even though neither satisfies both filters.

The only test targeting combined filters, capsule.service.spec.ts 'combines name and occasion filters', uses fixture data where the matching capsule satisfies both predicates and the non-matching capsule satisfies neither, so AND and OR produce identical result sets. The controller spec never exercises a combined-filter query at all. The defect ships with all 17 tests green. Independently rediscovers incidental finding IF-001.

IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md claims 24 capsule specs; the suite actually has 17. It also describes the combined-filter case as hand-verified three times and reviewer-signed-off, while that exact scenario is broken. Both the count and the verification narrative are false.
